name: cache-timer
description: Live countdown above the prompt until your session's prompt cache expires, with an optional keep-alive that keeps it warm while you're away

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: Assumed TTL until the mod learns the real one (model switch or an observed cache hit/miss)

keepAlive.title: Cache keep-alive
keepAlive.description: How long after your last prompt to keep refreshing the cache before it expires (each refresh is one cache read of the session)
